features.description: Scans installed ECUs via Gateway installation list and extracts active/pending fault codes.
features.vehicle_models: All supported VAG vehicles (Golf, Passat, Octavia, Leon, A3, A4, A6, Tiguan, Touareg)
features.ecu_matching_rules: Gateway DID 0x04A1 returns 4-byte record per installed ECU
features.security: None
features.request_template: 22 04 A1 (Gateway list) -> 19 02 8D (DTCs on each ECU)
features.response_parser: Gateway returns 4-byte records; UDS returns 59 02 [Mask] [3-byte DTC] [1-byte Status]
features.allowed_values: List of installed ECUs with FaultCode models
features.prerequisites: Ignition ON, engine running or off, battery voltage > 12.0V
features.postconditions: Vehicle ECU status map populated

features.description: Clears emission and non-emission diagnostic trouble codes across selected or all ECUs.
features.ecu_matching_rules: All active ECUs in Gateway list
features.security: None
features.request_template: 14 FF FF FF
features.prerequisites: Ignition ON, engine OFF (clearing while driving prohibited by ECU)
features.postconditions: Fault memory erased, MIL indicator extinguished

features.description: Opens rear brake caliper pistons into service position for brake pad replacement, and resets position after installation.
features.vehicle_models: Passat (B6/B7/B8), Golf (7/8), Tiguan, Octavia (3/4), Superb, A3, A4, A6, Q3, Q5
features.ecu_matching_rules: Presence of EPB ECU (0x53) in Gateway installation list
features.security: None required on standard MQB/PQ; SFD on MQB2020
features.allowed_values: Open Pistons, Close Pistons, Calibrate Thickness
features.prerequisites: Vehicle stationary on level ground, parking brake switch OFF, battery charger connected (voltage > 12.4V)
features.postconditions: Caliper pistons fully retracted; brake pads free to replace
features.polling: Poll DID 0x0102 every 500ms until motor current drops and status indicates idle
features.error_handling: NRC 0x31 (RequestOutOfRange: parking brake physically applied), NRC 0x22 (ConditionsNotCorrect)

features.description: Initiates forced particulate filter soot burn-off while stationary in service bay or during emergency driving cycle.
features.vehicle_models: All TDI Common Rail models (1.6 TDI, 2.0 TDI, 3.0 TDI)
features.ecu_matching_rules: ECU 0x01 identification part number matches TDI / EDC17 / MD1 engine
features.security: SecurityAccess 0x27 (0x01 / 0x02) with Login 27971 or 12233 where required
features.read_op: DID 0x2201 / DID 0x2260 (Soot mass measured & calculated in grams)
features.request_template: Stationary: 31 01 05 3D 04 00 00 | Emergency: 31 01 03 05 04 00 00
features.allowed_values: Start Stationary Regen, Start Driving Regen
features.prerequisites: Coolant temp > 70°C, exhaust gas temp > 150°C, fuel tank > 1/4, hood closed, transmission in P/N
features.postconditions: Soot mass reduced below 5.0 grams
features.polling: Read Live Data DIDs every 1000ms: Soot Mass, EGT Bank 1 Temp, Regen Duration
features.error_handling: Abort if Coolant Temp > 115°C or safety interlock breached

features.description: Registers new starter battery replacement by programming capacity (Ah), technology (AGM/EFB/Wet), manufacturer, and serial number.
